name: OpenRush
description: Connect OpenRush to Claude to research keywords, analyze competitors, check live Google search results, and track your own search traffic. Claude can pull real ranking data from live Google SERPs and a full search index, find your competitors and keyword gaps, audit a site for issues, and read your Google Search Console and Google Analytics for real clicks, sources, and positions. Useful for finding keywords to target, seeing why a competitor outranks you, or tracking your website traffic over time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OpenRush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OpenRush to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.openrush.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OpenRush MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OpenRush lists 16 MCP tools, including audit_site, compare_backlink_gap, compare_keyword_coverage, describe_capabilities, discover_competitors, export_dataset, get_search_performance, inspect_backlinks, inspect_domain, inspect_keyword, inspect_page, and inspect_search_visibility.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OpenRush?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to OpenRush in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
OpenRush requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OpenRush is developed by OpenRush. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
